name: EPIC 212018792
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 6.8 solar radii and 0.98 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212018792 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.814841 (16th-84th percentiles 6.588106-7.058238), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212018792 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2823.867188 (16th-84th percentiles 2744.921875-2905.507812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,824 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.98 solar masses and 6.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,785 K at its surface.
